# Go preserves offline discoverability while exposing its own smaller vocabulary.
env SKYGO_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:1
skygo --help
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'jobs'
stdout 'plan'
stdout 'run'
stdout 'targets'
! stdout '\x1b'
! stderr .
skygo -h
stdout 'Usage:'
! stderr .
skygo jobs --help
stdout 'cancel'
stdout 'get'
stdout 'list'
stdout 'logs'
! stderr .
skygo help jobs logs
stdout 'jobs logs ID'
stdout '--follow'
stdout '--offset'
stdout 'interrupting does not cancel the job'
! stderr .
skygo run --help
stdout '--file'
stdout '--request-id'
stdout '--wait'
stdout 'unsuccessful jobs exit 2'
! stderr .
skygo plan --help
stdout '--file'
! stdout '--wait'
! stderr .
! skygo unknown-command
stderr 'unknown command'
! stdout .

stdout '^SKYGO_EXIT_CODE=1\n$'
